sql: WITH target_data AS (SELECT td.tid, td.target_type, td.tax_id FROM target_dictionary td WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697668'), assay_map AS (SELECT a.assay_id, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_data td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL) SELECT am.assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM assay_map am JOIN activities a ON am.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_data td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, am.assay_chembl_id LIMIT 1000

up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1697668 (Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1). Return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, target tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Include only rows where the standard relation is '=' and the pChEMBL value is not null. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697668'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
